title: Hazel and the Hollow
author: Hazel Dravenmoor
blurb: Wendell Brightwater, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
